subject_group: 6.2.12 Vehicle control function pilot vehicle interface

versions.text:
Standard: Each inceptor functions to the maximum displacement and maximum force that can be imparted by the flight crew without obstruction. Each mechanical device that transmits flight crew commands, from inceptor to actuator, functions to the maximum displacement and maximum force that can be imparted by the flight crew without obstruction. Units, components, and parts which transmit command mechanically: a. Have strength such that the limit load is 1.15X the design load and the ultimate load is 1.5X the design load. b. Maintain strength for the full-life duty cycle. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Examination.
(1) Review of the requirements and design of inceptors to ensure displacement, flight crew forces, and strength requirements are established. Analysis.
  (1) Conduct material analysis to determine material ultimate load.
  (2) Conduct structural analysis to determine unit, component, or part strength.
  (3) Conduct analysis to determine the duty cycle of each inceptor. Test.
    (1) Lab test: Conduct tests to verify structural characteristics of components and assemblies.
    (2) Lab test: Conduct test in a flight crew evaluation facility, a handling qualities simulation facility, or SIL to verify inceptors can achieve maximum displacement and maximum force without obstruction.
